summary: TFI International Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release dated September 15, 2026, in which its Board of Directors declared a quarterly dividend of US$0.47 per outstanding common share. The dividend is payable October 15, 2026, to shareholders of record at the close of business on September 30, 2026. No advisor, premium, or deal mechanics are disclosed. As a foreign private issuer, this maps to a US Form 8-K current report. The declaration continues the company's ordinary capital-return cadence; the risk-arb focus is limited to dividend sustainability and any future payout changes.
